style: cinematic TV commercial still, photorealistic, warm soft evening light, cozy modern Canadian family living room, snow visible through the window, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look, natural skin tones

people.abbu: a friendly Pakistani father in his early 50s with a short neat salt-and-pepper beard, rectangular glasses, wearing a navy blue knit sweater
people.ammi: a Pakistani mother in her mid 40s wearing a maroon shalwar kameez with a cream dupatta over her shoulders
people.bilal: a cheerful Pakistani teenage boy about 16 with short black hair wearing a grey hoodie
people.dadi: a sweet elderly Pakistani grandmother in her 70s with a white dupatta covering her hair and round glasses

scenes.image: medium shot of {abbu} sitting on a beige sofa holding an opened paper bill letter in both hands, staring at it with a shocked face, raised eyebrows
scenes.motion: the man stares at the bill in shock, his eyes widen and he lowers his glasses, slow camera push in
scenes.ur: یہ کیبل کا بل... پھر سے ایک سو بیس ڈالر!

scenes.image: medium shot of {ammi} standing in the kitchen doorway with her hands on her hips, looking annoyed toward the camera
scenes.motion: the woman shakes her head with annoyance and gestures with one hand, subtle camera movement
scenes.ur: اور ہمارے ڈرامے پھر بھی نہیں آتے!
scenes.en: And our dramas still don't even come on!

scenes.image: medium shot of {bilal} leaning over the back of the sofa with a big confident smile, holding up a black TV remote control
scenes.motion: the teenage boy grins and raises the TV remote, giving a thumbs up with his other hand, camera slowly pushes in
scenes.ur: ابو، کیبل ٹی وی لگا لیں۔ بالکل فری ہے!
scenes.en: Dad, just get Cable TV. It's totally free!

scenes.image: close-up of {abbu} looking surprised and curious, eyebrows raised, a hopeful half smile, sofa and warm lamp behind him
scenes.motion: the man tilts his head with surprise and then breaks into a hopeful smile

scenes.image: wide shot from behind a large flat screen TV showing a colorful cricket match, the whole family on the sofa facing the camera: {dadi} in the middle, {abbu}, {ammi} and {bilal}, all cheering happily with raised arms
scenes.motion: the family jumps up cheering and clapping joyfully, the grandmother claps her hands, lively celebration
scenes.ur: واہ! کرکٹ بھی، اور میرا ڈرامہ بھی!
scenes.en: Wow! Cricket, and my drama too!

scenes.image: medium shot of {abbu} laughing happily while tearing a paper bill in half with both hands, the family blurred in the background
scenes.motion: the man laughs and tears the paper bill in half, pieces of paper fall, joyful mood

end.ur: کیبل ٹی وی۔ بالکل فری۔ آج ہی لگائیں: ٹی وی ڈاٹ بلک بازار ڈاٹ سی اے
end.en: Cable TV. Totally free. Get it today: tv.bulkbazaar.ca
